expectations.text: Censuses by file/lines changed rather than only reading commit subjects
expectations.evidence: "Census was by lines-per-file, not by message" — backed by actual file-level aggregation: "**29 distinct migration files named `wire_cert_readiness_realtime.sql`** and **26 named `grader_evidence_gate_and_truthful_onboard.sql`**" (checksummed all 29), "Local versions dated ≥ 20260809: **220**", "1,363 migration versions against 1,145 recorded remotely — 218 local-only".

expectations.text: Includes automated commits (auto: sync / stop-hook) rather than filtering them out
expectations.evidence: "932 commits, of which **653 are automated** (auto-sync, pre-push hook, Lovable bot). A subject-line skim would have shown you 279 commits and missed most of the week — the automated ones carry the 814k-row facet corpus, the session logs, and the schema dictionary regeneration." Author breakdown includes auto-sync 312 and pre-push hook 222.

expectations.text: Surfaces at least one large artifact that landed via an automated commit (e.g. coin_facet_tokens.tsv, lowtier_solo_coins.tsv, facet-match-scorecard.tsv)
expectations.evidence: "the automated ones carry the 814k-row facet corpus, the session logs, and the schema dictionary regeneration" — identifies the facet corpus by size (814k rows, matching coin_facet_tokens.tsv) and attributes it to the automated commits, though it does not name the .tsv file itself.

expectations.text: Verifies at least one load-bearing claim against a live/deployed source rather than trusting the commit message
expectations.evidence: "**I verified this is deployed right now**, not just committed — pulled the live index bundle, followed it to the lazy `CameraInput` chunk, and found the `lkupScanStats` marker present." Also a live anon-key probe table (before/now: 200→401, 204→401) and live `pg_get_functiondef('public.onboard_minor_grader')` on prod showing the bare `synth:` shape.

expectations.text: Reports a doc-vs-reality contradiction it found
expectations.evidence: "## Documentation that has gone stale" — three, incl. "**`CLAUDE.md` says `core.hooksPath` is the default `.git/hooks` and the in-repo `.githooks/*` is NOT active.** It is now set to `.githooks` ... That line is inverted."

expectations.text: Retracts or corrects at least one of its own intermediate conclusions
expectations.evidence: "## Retracted this session" with three explicit self-corrections, e.g. "**I said the zero-identity onboarding fix was working cleanly** — cut at 'since Aug 14 12:00' I got 0 of 26 certs with null identity. That window was a tail slice. Widened ... it's **53 of 116**."
